research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Mapbox is researching viewport systems for dynamically framing a map based on updating data, using telemetry driven states to automatically adjust map parameters and display important features. It develops efficient graphical element top surface rendering in digital maps, dynamic building extrusion in electronic maps, map tile culling for globe representations, stationary classifiers for geographic route trace data, and methods for adjusting route travel time estimates in an electronic map system, covering visualization, data processing, and routing.

overview_description.description: Mapbox is a technology underpinning location-aware businesses and applications that equips organizations with AI-enhanced tools and data to power navigation for people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers and nearly 40 percent of Fortune 500 companies have chosen Mapbox because of the platform's flexibility, security, and privacy compliance.

about_short_description.short_description: Mapbox develops a location data platform for mobile and web applications.

product.name: Mapbox Maps
product.description: APIs, SDKs, and map-rendering tools for building customizable, interactive maps across web, mobile, automotive, and other applications.

product.name: Mapbox Navigation
product.description: Routing, traffic-aware travel times, and turn-by-turn guidance for mobile, automotive, logistics, electric-vehicle, and other navigation applications.

product.name: Mapbox Search
product.description: Location search and geocoding services for finding, validating, and enriching addresses, places, points of interest, and geographic coordinates.

product.name: Mapbox Data Products
product.description: Commercial geospatial datasets covering traffic, population movement, and global administrative, postal, statistical, and locality boundaries.

product.name: Mapbox Location AI
product.description: Geospatial AI tools that provide location context to AI applications, agents, assistants, and developer workflows.

product.name: Mapbox Tiling Service
product.description: A cloud service for converting vector and raster geospatial data into optimized, private tilesets for application delivery and visualization.
